title: 潮声苏醒

selectedMaster.selection: 人工首检：高空一位天使、两翼和一号角清晰；地面五人和一犬可逐一辨认，位于连续海岸石台；未做透明、细部或倾斜验收。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 portrait master artwork for a layered interactive tarot holographic card, Judgement, theme title “潮声苏醒”.
Primary request: exactly one luminous starry sky angel in upper center, with exactly two clearly visible wings and exactly one trumpet; angel has deliberately soft semi-transparent dark wing edges but remains visibly intact. Below, exactly five human figures stand on one broad continuous safe coastal stone terrace in a three-front/two-back arrangement, responding to dawn; exactly one dog is visible at the front side, unobscured. Keep all five people and the dog grounded with contact shadows on continuous stone ground.
Scene: blue sea coast at dawn, coral-gold light through clouds, gentle sea mist; angel separated in the high sky. Composition: vertical 2:3, angel upper center, ground group lower half, wide unbroken terrace through lower bleed. Style: richly detailed premium painterly fantasy tarot, readable faces and anatomy.
Constraints: exactly 1 angel / 2 wings / 1 trumpet / 5 people / 1 dog. No extra people, animals, wings, trumpets, duplicate bodies or cropped feet. No text, border, watermark, checkerboard, or baked holographic effects. Do not erase dark translucent wing details into brightness.
generationRuns.conclusion: selected as master candidate; opaque RGB only, not a transparent layer or user-approved art

rigidGroups: angel and soft transparent garment/wing edges
supportGeometry: continuous stone terrace through lower bleed

lineart.algorithm: luminance Sobel edge pass constrained to alpha >245

implementedAnimations: RuiC viewer card auto motion; angel, people, dog and support terrace remain within their recorded foreground image plane

assets.conclusion: all five layers share 1024×1536; required RGBA layers contain true transparency and visible pixels

manualVisual.conclusion: manual review found no green fringe, duplicate angel/figure/dog, detached feet/paws or broken terrace support; 320px remains legible

webDesktop390.summary: 33/33 real WebGL checks including desktop and 390px

checks.fiveSlotThumbnailComparison: not-run; full five-slot comparison belongs after the base slot is completed

blackWhiteGrayAlpha.conclusion: recorded alpha review confirms soft wing/cloth transparency remains visible and required figures, dog, limbs/paws and terrace are intact

checks.extremeTiltFourDirections: partial; browser verifier exercises both horizontal and vertical drag, with manual right/left screenshots; dedicated four-direction image review remains

knownIssues: Offline Blender material/compositor is not pixel-identical to browser GLSL material.
Five-slot comparison and dedicated four-direction extreme-tilt image review remain.
nextAction: 用户统一审美验收；技术与当前整改项复验已完成。

productionDetail.composition: 天使上中，五人以三前二后排海岸，一犬在最前侧
productionDetail.supportGeometry: 五人与犬及完整岸台同组，天使空中独立区域
productionDetail.connectedGroup: 天使、双翼与号角一组保留软透明；五人与犬在地面稳定组，若不能可靠多主体分层先同一主层；本主题支撑归属：五人与犬及完整岸台同组，天使空中独立区域
productionDetail.foilMask: 号角边、羽翼内部稀疏线与地面衣缘
productionDetail.specificQA: 地面恰好五人一犬；高空一天使两翼一号角；半透明暗部不能被亮度抠图删除
productionDetail.samplePrinciple: 借鉴五样本的完整承接、真实透明、主题材质和极端倾斜复核，不按槽位强行套题材。
productionDetail.motion: 仅少量前景微光呼吸；主体、核心符号和承重结构不自动相对运动。
productionDetail.backgroundOwnership: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。
